verdict.rationale: Whether a search API uses customer queries or data for AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or any data-use policy. The community items concern Terms of Use limits on the customer's own AI-inference use of API responses, not whether Brave trains models on user data, so they do not support this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
